evals.prompt: Readers say the hosted toolbox report is hard to understand. Audit it.
evals.expected: Names readers and tasks first, captures screenshots and metrics with scripts/capture.cjs, hands them to a fresh auditor without source or diff, and returns U1-U10, J1-J4 and task scores with severity-ranked findings.

evals.prompt: I just redesigned the report overview. Score my change so we can merge it.
evals.expected: Refuses to self-score; runs a blind re-audit by a new auditor on the same routes and tasks without the earlier scores, then compares score tables and serious axe violations before calling the change done.

evals.prompt: Make the portal page more fun: add confetti and animated gradients everywhere.
evals.expected: Treats joy as Kano delighters tied to a task (progress, achievement), keeps every usability score and contrast intact, and declines decoration that hides data or slows a primary task.
